Name: Halloween Pets
Author: Anthri
Description:
Halloween-themed mod that adds an alternative texture for the cat and dog that makes them look like a skeleton version.

That's it! AT means you can turn it on and off whenever you want, and it changes nothing else except the appearance of the animals.



UPDATE : fixed the dog running bug, as well as smapi being unable to read the update key

Downloads.Description: Fixes the dog running bug, and smapi not registering the update key

Manifest.Name: (AT) Halloween Pets
Manifest.Description: Adds skeleton-style textures for the dog and cat!
